title: UI Frame Pipeline v2 Fearless Refactor
problem: Fret's current retained UiTree, declarative mounting, view-cache, paint-cache, and editor-specific hot paths are correct enough to optimize locally but do not yet form one direct, phase-attributable execution model. This lane owns the documented, evidence-driven migration to explicit build/layout/prepaint/paint/render boundaries, complete old-path cleanup, and perf-gated editor-grade validation until the completion contract in PROGRESS.md is satisfied.

repro.summary: Start from the code-editor resize/paint path that already exposes layout containment and paint attribution pressure.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag perf ui-code-editor-resize-probes --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --sort time --top 15 --json --perf-baseline docs/workstreams/perf-baselines/ui-code-editor-resize-probes.macos-m4.v2.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full

continue_policy.notes: ADR 0327 is accepted as the Frame Pipeline v2 target contract in M0_CONTRACT_FREEZE_2026-05-14.md, and the code-editor vertical slice is closed in CLOSEOUT_AUDIT_2026-05-14.md, but the global refactor is not complete. PROGRESS.md is the first-open progress ledger and completion contract. M4C_BOUNDARY_HINT_API_SLICE_2026-05-14.md replaced first-party direct contained_layout authoring with ViewBoundaryHints, so the remaining containment work is internal runtime consolidation rather than public naming design. M4D_VIEW_CACHE_BUILD_BOUNDARY_STORE_SLICE_2026-05-14.md consolidated element-runtime view-cache build-time rendered/next side maps into ViewCacheBuildBoundaryStore, but final ViewBoundaryState ownership/retention is still open. M4E_BOUNDARY_PAINT_CACHE_ENTRY_SLICE_2026-05-14.md moved boundary-node PaintCacheEntry ownership into ViewBoundaryState::paint_cache, and M4F_NODE_PAINT_CACHE_FALLBACK_DELETION_SLICE_2026-05-14.md deleted the remaining Node::paint_cache fallback by routing plain retained entries through UiTree::boundary_paint_cache_entries, with migration into ViewBoundaryState::paint_cache when a node becomes a true runtime boundary. M4G_PREVIOUS_FRAME_PAINT_RECORDING_SLICE_2026-05-14.md split previous-frame paint recording storage into PreviousFramePaintRecording, and M4H_PREVIOUS_FRAME_PAINT_REPLAY_SPAN_SLICE_2026-05-14.md moved replay range validation, op slicing, and text side-index replay into that carrier, but PaintCacheState still owns the carrier until the final replay owner decision. The transitional plain-entry side store remains open. Continue this lane through small evidence-backed slices until the final boundary model owns the canonical build/layout/prepaint/paint diagnostics and reuse path across at least two proof surfaces, broader view-cache/paint-cache ownership is resolved, replaced old runtime paths are deleted, and final correctness/perf/layering/deletion evidence is recorded.
